description: List a user's Morpho V1 and V2 vault positions with portfolio totals. Paginate by passing back `cursor` until it is null.

asset_addresses.description: Vault asset addresses to keep. Requires chain_ids; matches positions whose vault asset is one of these addresses on one of the chain_ids.

chain_ids.description: Chains to keep. Defaults to every exposed chain.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Page size. Defaults to 100, at most 1000.

sort_by.description: Sort field. Positions with a null sort value come last.

name: morpho_get_vault_positions

count_total.description: Positions matching the filters, over all pages.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

assets_usd.description: Null when the vault asset has no price; 0 when `assets` is 0.

pnl_assets.description: Earnings on the position in vault asset units, computed from the user's indexed deposits and withdrawals. Null when unknown.

pnl_usd.description: Earnings in USD. Null when `pnl_assets` is null or its USD value is unknown; 0 when `pnl_assets` is 0, even if the vault asset has no price.

apy_breakdown.description: Native APY split into organic and surplus-boost (donation) parts, gross and net of fees. All fields come from one realtime accrual snapshot (fees included) and reconcile with each other; consumers should take the headline from this object rather than mix it with the top-level apy / net_apy_excluding_rewards, which come from a separate realtime read. Null when the vault has no accrual checkpoint or the breakdown read fails.

apy.description: Native: gross APY of this snapshot; equals organic_apy + surplus_boost_apy. Decimal, 0.05 = 5%. An infinite value is clamped to the largest finite number.

net_apy_excluding_rewards.description: Net: apy after this snapshot's performance and management fees, excluding rewards. Decimal. Null when the value is not a number; an infinite value is clamped to the largest finite number.

organic_apy.description: Native: what apy would be without the surplus, capped by the vault's maxRate. Decimal. An infinite value is clamped to the largest finite number.

organic_net_apy_excluding_rewards.description: Net: organic_apy after the same fees. Decimal. Null when the value is not a number; an infinite value is clamped to the largest finite number.

surplus_boost_active.description: Native: whether apy is pinned to the maxRate APY by the surplus.

surplus_boost_apy.description: Native: APY points added by the surplus (donations), only the part under the maxRate cap. Decimal. An infinite value is clamped to the largest finite number.

surplus_boost_net_apy_excluding_rewards.description: Net: net_apy_excluding_rewards minus organic_net_apy_excluding_rewards, floored at 0; null when either is null. Decimal. An infinite value is clamped to the largest finite number.

price_usd.description: Null when the token has no price.

yield_apr.description: Native yield of the token itself (e.g. staking), a fraction. Null when unknown.

yield_apy.description: Native yield of the token itself (e.g. staking), as an APY fraction. Null when unknown.

aum_usd.description: Assets under management across the curator's vaults, in USD. The internal source reports 0 when the AUM is unknown.

image.description: Null when the curator has no logo.

exposure_usd.description: USD value of the vault asset supplied against this collateral (or held idle). Null when the vault asset has no price. The internal source still reports 0 when the vault state is unavailable.

management_fee.description: Annualized management fee as a fraction. Null for V1 vaults.

max_apy.description: V2 only: the APY equivalent of the vault's max rate, which caps the native APY. Null for V1 vaults or when no max rate is set.

net_apy.description: Net APY: native APY net of fees plus the rewards-only APRs in `rewards`, a fraction. Null when unknown.

net_apy_excluding_rewards.description: Native APY net of performance and management fees, excluding rewards: a fraction. Null when unknown.

rewards.description: The composed reward set: rewards on the vault itself plus rewards forwarded from the markets it supplies, directly or through its adapters. Each `supply_apr` is rewards-only.

supply_apr.description: Rewards-only supply APR, excluding the native APY: a fraction.

total_assets_usd.description: Vault total assets in USD. Null when the vault asset has no price. The internal source still reports 0 when the vault state is unavailable.

deprecated.description: True for a `not_whitelisted` warning on a vault that was listed before (non-empty listing history in the source metadata).

assets.description: Positions per vault asset, ignoring `asset_addresses` but still narrowed by `chain_ids`.

value.description: Asset selector `<chain_id>:<address>`; filter on it with `chain_ids` + `asset_addresses`.

chain_ids.description: Positions per chain, ignoring `chain_ids` but still narrowed by `asset_addresses`, whose selectors embed chain ids.

totals.description: Portfolio totals over every exposed position, ignoring `chain_ids` and `asset_addresses`.

rewards.description: Rewards-only APR per reward token over the whole portfolio: weighted by `assets_usd` and divided by `total_assets_usd`, so positions without that reward count as 0, unpriced positions are left out, and the APRs add up.

supply_apr.description: Rewards-only supply APR, excluding the native APY: a fraction.

total_net_apy.description: Net APY (native net of fees plus rewards), weighted by `assets_usd`. Null when no position has both.

total_net_apy_excluding_rewards.description: Native APY net of fees, excluding rewards, weighted by `assets_usd`. Null when no position has both.

count_total.description: Positions matching the filters, over all pages.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.
